syllabus_topics: Kinematics: position, velocity and acceleration vectors; rectilinear and circular motions.
Forces and reference frames: relative motion; inertia; conservation laws and space-time symmetries.
Work and energy: kinetic energy; conservative forces; potential and mechanical energies; energy conservation and time invariance.
Linear momentum: system of particles and center of mass; conservation of linear momentum and translational invariance; collisions.
Angular and torque moments: torque; equilibrium conditions.
Gravitation: Kepler's laws and central forces; conservation of angular momentum and isotropy of space.
Rigid body: moment of inertia; statics; translation and rotation; gyroscope.
Oscillations: simple harmonic, damped and forced; resonance.

Waves: sinusoidal and characteristic parameters; transverse and longitudinal, standing (vibrating string), plane and spherical; beats; Huygens' principle; reflection, refraction and dispersion; interference and diffraction.
